verdict.rationale: The official Go SDK supports multi-domain availability checks in one call (`CheckWithContext(ctx, domains...)`), so bulk search is covered. Register and renew are exposed only as per-domain API calls, so bulk action means scripting against the API. A community report of re-doing many GoDaddy-to-Namecheap transfers suggests multi-domain transfers happen, but no bulk transfer tool is documented. Missing for 10: native bulk registration and renewal, bulk nameserver changes, documented bulk transfer tooling, and independent hands-on corroboration of portfolio-scale operations.
